slides.title: Key Stretching
slides.teach: Repeated or memory-intensive processing that increases the cost of deriving a key from a password.

course.learn: Repeated or memory-intensive processing that increases the cost of deriving a key from a password.

breakdown.explanation: Make each password guess intentionally expensive.

course.why: A small delay is tolerable for one legitimate login but expensive across millions or billions of attacker guesses.
course.example: A password derivation takes a small deliberate amount of time to slow brute-force attempts.
course.exam: Key stretching = MAKE EACH GUESS EXPENSIVE.
course.check_q: What technique deliberately increases the cost of password guesses?

cards.name: Key Stretching
cards.definition: Repeated or memory-intensive processing that increases the cost of deriving a key from a password.

blocks.title: Why deliberately slow it down?
items: A small delay is usually acceptable for a legitimate user.
Example: Deriving a password key takes a fraction of a second.
The same delay multiplied across huge numbers of guesses slows attackers dramatically.
Example: Brute-force cracking becomes much more costly.
blocks.example: Memory: Small delay for user · huge cumulative cost for attacker.

questions.q: A password-storage design deliberately makes each password-derived key computation slower to reduce brute-force efficiency. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: Key stretching increases the computational cost of each password guess.

questions.q: Why can key stretching help against brute-force attacks?
choices: A small per-guess delay becomes expensive across huge numbers of guesses
It replaces the password with a public certificate
It hides the password inside an image
questions.explanation: The cumulative cost grows dramatically for attackers making many guesses.

questions.q: Which technology is an example associated with password key stretching?
questions.explanation: PBKDF2 is a password-based key derivation function used for key stretching.

questions.q: Which phrase best summarizes key stretching?
questions.explanation: Key stretching deliberately increases the cost of deriving keys from passwords.
